$comment: The blocks: whole starting pages the init bin copies into a consumer's app, composed from the library alone. Each lists every file it writes, at its target path (app/** lands in the app router folder, components/** beside it). A file may belong to more than one block; init never overwrites, so the shared shell is written once. scripts/validate-blocks.mjs holds this file to the tree and the site's previews.

blocks.name: app-shell
blocks.label: App shell
blocks.description: A sidebar in your pick of the three shell modes, a top bar with search, notifications, settings and AI, a page header, and an empty page with the spacing set.

blocks.name: dashboard
blocks.label: Dashboard
blocks.description: The app shell with a row of stats, two panels and a project table, stacking down to one column on a phone.

blocks.name: settings
blocks.label: Settings
blocks.description: A standard page per settings section, opened from the sidebar’s side panel: rows of a label, its help, the value and an Edit that changes it in place.

blocks.name: notifications
blocks.label: Notifications
blocks.description: The full list a notification panel’s See all opens: All and Unread tabs, a category filter, and rows by day, each read on open and cleared on its own.

blocks.name: planner
blocks.label: Planner
blocks.description: The app shell with a plan across weeks, each cell editable with totals down and across, over a queue of requests to decide.

blocks.name: sign-in
blocks.label: Sign in
blocks.description: A centred sign-in card with email and password, remember me and a single sign-on route.

blocks.name: shader-scene
blocks.label: Shader scene
blocks.description: A shader scene of your own on a stage, written in GLSL from the theme's colour roles, with a slider for each setting it declares.

blocks.name: docs
blocks.label: Docs
blocks.description: A documentation page: a site header, a long sidebar of pages, an article with tabbed install commands and live examples, an on-this-page rail and a footer.

blocks.name: landing
blocks.label: Landing page
blocks.description: A product's front page in bands: a hero, customer names, features, numbers, quotes, questions and a closing call to act, under a site header and footer.

blocks.name: pricing
blocks.label: Pricing
blocks.description: Plans side by side with a monthly or yearly choice, each price written for a locale, over a table comparing every feature.
